nodes.label: D0 No crashes, guaranteed
nodes.rationale: Top priority directive; wins every conflict. Nothing may crash game, server or worldgen, or cause a per-tick console loop; checked against vanilla limits by decompiling.

nodes.label: D1 Optimization
nodes.rationale: No allocations, LINQ or uncached assets in hot paths; visuals client-only; sync only on change.

nodes.label: D2 Co-op compatibility
nodes.rationale: Server decides NPC/world/random outcomes; player projectiles are owner-only; test singleplayer, host+client, dedicated.

nodes.label: D3 Balance (Expert first)
nodes.rationale: Every combat stat has a CSV row against a same-tier vanilla anchor within +-15% effective DPS; all numbers are Expert values because the user plays Expert.

nodes.label: D4 Pixel art
nodes.rationale: 1x drawn, 2x nearest-neighbor export, Cogpunk palette, top-left light, no mixels, no semi-transparent pixels.

nodes.label: D5 Visual proof (GIF/PNG)
nodes.rationale: Animated results need a GIF built from frames or an offline simulation; in-game capture optional; outdated media deleted to save project size.

nodes.label: Attack-pattern fairness rules
nodes.rationale: Telegraphs of >=30/20/12 ticks by tier, dodgeable without wings early, spread targeting in co-op.

nodes.label: Seamless blocks rule (D4 rule 7)
nodes.rationale: Blocks merge into one clump like vanilla ores: no per-tile bevel, outlines only on exposed sides.

nodes.label: Art direction for detailed entities (3/4 view, multiplane, Metal Slug detail)
nodes.rationale: User rule 2026-10-26 for bosses, minibosses, detailed mobs: three-quarter view, up to three parallax layers from generator-rendered poses, death cinematics.

nodes.label: Stable pixels rule (no colour flicker)
nodes.rationale: Part-space lighting and whole-pixel loops because rust/shading visibly changed colour between frames of Trash-Tr0m and Tar Tyrant.

nodes.label: Vanilla detail density rule
nodes.rationale: Measured against vanilla NPCs (pixel-art-study.md): chibi proportions, long ramps, part-space texture.

nodes.label: Boss-fight rules (defeat card, no spawns, despawn, art-matched hitboxes)
nodes.rationale: User rules 2026-10-26: Defeated card, BossFightSpawnRule, biome despawn, hitboxes from silhouette strips.

nodes.label: Steam resource (SteamPlayer)
nodes.rationale: Steam works like mana (user-set 2026-10-27); tank only from gear; refills 10 every 0.5 s after 1.5 s idle.

nodes.label: Architecture: Core/ engine vs Content/<Slice>/
nodes.rationale: Chosen after comparing Calamity, Starlight River and Spirit Reforged; feature-based Content slices with an engine Core.

nodes.label: 1.4.5 port readiness (prefer public hooks)
nodes.rationale: IL edits, detours and reflection are last resort and live in Core/Hooks so the future tModPorter port stays cheap.
